label: early copy phase (first output after <DEL>) in longer sequences
explanation: Fires only at the start of the copy phase and never during the original-token phase. About 82% of the activation mass falls on the step right after <DEL> (input = first original token, outputting original token 1). The rest is on the <DEL> step itself (11%, mostly for L=8-9) and on recall_idx 2 (7%, mostly for short L). Firing rate and magnitude grow with sequence length: active on 0.4% of steps at L=3 and 8.7% at L=9, with mass concentrated where to_go is 6-7. Token identity also changes magnitude: the strongest activations have first token b or z, and output tokens u, y, t raise the rate. It never fires from recall_idx 3 onward or in the original phase. Precision is limited because at recall_idx 1 it fires on only about 65% of long-L sequences, depending on the tokens involved.
